reports.one_line: A 21-station Auto LPG retailer in Telangana, Karnataka and Maharashtra raising ~Rs 50.75 crore of all-fresh money to add stations and cut debt -- genuinely profitable and growing, but selling a fuel that India has barely grown in a decade, with 99.75% of its gas from three suppliers and its trucking done by a promoter-owned company (S1)(S3)(S14).
